reports.title: FedEx Reports Strong Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For calendar year 2026, FedEx is revising its forecast as follows:

Financial Metric | Forecast Value1 | Additional Details & Exclusions
Revenue Growth | ~12% YoY | Compared to the prior forecast of ~11%.
Diluted EPS(Continuing Operations) | $35.30 to $35.90 | Compared to the prior forecast of $16.55 to $17.75 per diluted share, which excluded impacts related to MTM accounting for the FedEx Freight investment and gain on extinguishment of debt. Prior to additional CY26 MTM adjustments for retirement plan accounting.
Adjusted Diluted EPS(Continuing Operations) | $18.00 to $18.60 | Compared to the prior forecast of $16.90 to $18.10 per diluted share. Also excludes MTM adjustments for retirement plan accounting, adjustments related to MTM accounting for the FedEx Freight investment, gain on extinguishment of debt, and restructuring, exit and other costs.
Effective Tax Rate(ETR) | ~22.5% | Compared to the prior forecast of ~23%. Prior to MTM adjustments for retirement plan accounting, adjustments related to MTM accounting for the FedEx Freight investment, and a $263 million deferred income tax benefit on FedEx Supply Chain basis difference.
Pension Contributions | $475 million | Unchanged from the prior forecast.
Capital Spending | $3.9 billion | Unchanged from the prior forecast. Prioritizes investments in network optimization and efficiency improvement, including fleet and facility modernization and automation.
